reviews.review_text:
crystal u
Yakima, Washington3 contributions
0
Bad dinner experience
Oct 2025 • Family
Would NOT recommend this place at all. We picked out a grouper from their tank and told them how we would want it to be prepared which is just the whole fish “steamed”. Along with the other seafood we ordered, they gave us the receipt and we checked, great. Everything was as we ordered.

Food come out slow, which is fine. We’re not in a rush. When the fish finally come out, it was chopped out in pieces, pan fried. Head and tail wasn’t there. We said it wasn’t ours since we ordered a steamed fish. They bought it back in and 10 mins later, they bought out the steamed “fish” which had the head and tail and the pan fried pieces stuck inside to assemble it back into a whole fish. 

When I bought it to the waiter attention (cause obviously we know they screwed up), there was no apology and said they pan fried the fish before steaming it. What kind of excuse it that? A joke? Who pan fried then steam?? At this point, I was furious since I don’t like being lied to and was just expecting an explanation or acknowledgment that they just screwed up. (Own up to your mistake).

He spoke with the manager and came back to apology and said they will give us another dish which I wanted to just clear our bill and leave. We didn’t accept their free dish option and just finish up and left. 

I would absolutely never ever come back to this establishment and would not recommend anyone I know to come here since there are way more better seafood place to eat in Vietnam.
